resources.string: One-tap access to your favorite folders, with a storage usage overview

HexFile\'s activity log feature reads only the package and activity class name of the current window, so the floating window can show which app and screen was just opened. It never reads screen content, never connects to the network and never uploads anything; turning the switch off stops logging.
Recycle bin, backups, Smali output and downloads all live here. Existing files are not moved when you switch.
Left behind by a failed operation: .bakrepl (backup of the original) and .part (incomplete). This only lists them and touches nothing.
Root is available on this device. When off, every operation uses the regular file API.
No Root detected. Turning this on only means "allowed to try"; without su the regular API is still used.
Root disabled. Folders such as /data are no longer accessible.
With Shizuku installed and authorized, commands run as shell. Note: this is not root, so other apps\' private folders under /data/data (700) stay unreadable.
Shizuku disabled. Commands use the regular API.
A Shizuku confirmation dialog appears; choose Allow.
Shizuku authorized. Commands can now run with shell permission.
When on, this app appears in the Files app sidebar, and other apps’ “Open file” dialogs can pick it directly.
Now shown in the system file picker
Hidden. The system file picker no longer lists this app.
Opens the system picker so you can confirm the HexFile entry is there.
No file picker on this system: %1$s
Long-press an empty spot on the home screen → Widgets → HexFile, then drag the card out. It carries four shortcuts: working folder, downloads, images and recycle bin.
Re-reads storage usage (no effect when no widget is placed).
Shows the first frame for videos in the file list. When off, only a type badge appears (saves power and memory; recommended on older devices).
On. Reopen a folder to see video first frames.
Off, and the existing thumbnail cache was cleared.
Deletes cacheDir/vthumb; frames are extracted again on the next visit.
Forgets every resume position (videos start over next time).
No root; running as shell via Shizuku
No .bakrepl / .replacebak / .part in the working folder.\n\nBackups only appear when writing an archive fails, so an empty list is normal.
%1$d files, %2$s in total. Tap an item to delete just that one.
%1$s\n\nThis is the backup of %2$s and may hold the original content from before a failed replacement. Once deleted, it cannot be recovered here.
%1$s\n\nThis is an unfinished temporary file; deleting it does not affect completed files.
Delete failed (file may be in use)
A task is running — this file can\'t be deleted right now
%1$s\n\nCreate this folder and use it as the working folder?
Could not create it. Check storage permission or pick another location.
Could not save. Check storage permission.
Will switch back to %1$s\n\nThe recycle bin and backups in the current folder are not moved; they stay where they are.
